definitions.explanation: A company that is controlled by another company (the parent company), typically through majority ownership of its shares. The parent company is called 親会社.

examples.japanese: {子会社|こがいしゃ}を{設立|せつりつ}する。
あの{会社|かいしゃ}は{大手|おおて}メーカーの{子会社|こがいしゃ}だ。
examples.english: That company is a subsidiary of a major manufacturer.

examples.japanese: {親会社|おやがいしゃ}が{経営|けいえい}{不振|ふしん}になり、{子会社|こがいしゃ}も{売却|ばいきゃく}されることになった。
examples.english: The parent company fell into financial trouble, and the subsidiary was to be sold off as well.

notes:
USAGE:
A business term using the metaphor of parent and child: {親会社|おやがいしゃ} (parent company) and {子会社|こがいしゃ} (child company / subsidiary). There is also {孫会社|まごがいしゃ} (grandchild company), a subsidiary of a subsidiary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {子会社|こがいしゃ}を{設立|せつりつ}する: to establish a subsidiary
- {完全|かんぜん}{子会社|こがいしゃ}: wholly owned subsidiary
- {連結|れんけつ}{子会社|こがいしゃ}: consolidated subsidiary
- {子会社|こがいしゃ}{化|か}する: to make into a subsidiary

RELATED TERMS:
{親会社|おやがいしゃ} (parent company), {関連|かんれん}{会社|がいしゃ} (affiliated company), {孫会社|まごがいしゃ} (sub-subsidiary).
